title: Expo mobile on iOS and Android — order status on both phones
feature: Devin on Linux with the Android emulator (KVM), a macOS child session with Xcode and the iOS Simulator, multi-document blueprints with runs-on, Continuous Native Generation (expo prebuild), an optional Swift Expo module with a JS fallback
prerequisites: Repo cloned, Node 22, `npm install` done at the root
Lab 00 warm-up done once (framing stems and the update skeleton)
Linux path: a Devin session whose VM exposes `/dev/kvm` and the Android SDK (emulator, platform-tools, one x86_64 system image) — see `docs/blueprint.proposed.mobile.yaml`
Optional iOS path: permission to start a Devin session with platform `macos` (Xcode 16.1 or newer, iOS Simulator)

matrix.fixture: `MockStore` serves the seed in-process; the Orders tab lists the demo customer's orders including `packed` and `shipped` ones.
matrix.note: Zero credentials, no backend. Every Android criterion can be met on this path.

matrix.integration: Android emulator on the Linux session VM
matrix.fixture: `labs/13-expo-mobile/evidence/android/` holds reference screenshots from the course build.
matrix.note: Needs `/dev/kvm`; without it the emulator is too slow to be useful and you stop at `npm run build` (expo export).

matrix.integration: macOS Devin session (Xcode, iOS Simulator) — optional
matrix.fixture: `labs/13-expo-mobile/evidence/ios/` holds the reference Simulator screenshots and build notes from the course build.
matrix.note: Org must allow the `macos` platform. Without it, items 6–8 are 'not exercised' and the lab is still complete.

matrix.fixture: Mock mode stands in for it.
matrix.note: Needs `npm run db:up`, migrate, seed and `npm run dev -w services/api` (port 3001); the emulator reaches the host at `http://10.0.2.2:3001`.

not_exercised: Haptic feel on a physical iPhone (the Simulator cannot vibrate; it only proves the module is linked and called)
App Store / Play Store signing, TestFlight and EAS Build (cloud builds)
Live `services/api` mode on either platform in the reference run

scenarios.clean_state: No `apps/mobile/android/` or `apps/mobile/ios/` folder exists, `git status` is clean, and `npm run build --workspace apps/mobile` ends with an Android `expo export` into `apps/mobile/dist`. No emulator is running yet (`adb devices` lists nothing). Without Docker, skip the first command: mock mode needs only Node.

injectors.name: snapshot-mismatch
injectors.behaviour: Start the session from a snapshot built before the Android SDK step was added: `emulator -list-avds` is empty or the system image is missing. Decide whether to install by hand or fix the blueprint, and say which one the next engineer will thank you for.

injectors.name: prebuild-drift
injectors.behaviour: Change `android.package` or add a plugin in `apps/mobile/app.json` after `android/` was generated. The next `expo run:android` uses the stale native project. Detect it and recover without hand-editing `android/`.

injectors.name: ios-only-native-dependency
injectors.behaviour: The Cart tab must say `Haptics: JS fallback (no-op)` on Android. If the Android build fails on `harbourline-haptics`, the module's platform list or import path is wrong — explain why the JS fallback, not a platform `if`, keeps Android working.

injectors.name: xcode-version
injectors.behaviour: The macOS machine has more than one Xcode, or the default one is too old for Expo SDK 54. Select the right one with `DEVELOPER_DIR` (or `xcode-select`) and record which one in the report.
